source.title: Quantum-Fisher-information-aware optimization yields a quantum reservoir advantage over tuned classical reservoirs

method: Audit |d<O>/dtheta|^2 <= F_Q(theta) * Var(O) on the analytic pure-qubit family cos(theta)|0> + sin(theta)|1>, with X and Z observables.

negative_controls: zero-QFI direction with nonzero slope is rejected
slope above the QFI envelope is rejected
test_summary.environment: isolated local harness; not the full repository checkout or CI

limitations: The helper audits supplied scalar QFI, variance and slope; it does not calculate QFI from arbitrary density matrices.
The test checks the single-observable response inequality, not the full retrained-loss gradient decomposition in the preprint.
The model is analytic and does not represent a hardware or provider measurement.
No quantum advantage, accepted-task economics, memory/storage replacement or physical-law discovery is established.
